title: exercises_down
description: Phone → watch. One batch of the user's exercise list — the catalog every routine draws from and the list the free-workout picker offers. The phone sends the whole list in batches of at most 100; the wrist stores each batch as it arrives and uses the list only when every batch of one version is present, until then keeping the list it had. Reference data: the phone owns the catalog, the watch reads it and never edits it.

catalogVersion.description: The version of the whole exercise list this batch belongs to. An opaque string the wrist echoes back; the phone derives it from the list's own content.

batchIndex.description: This batch's position in the list, 0-based, so it is always below batchCount.

batchCount.description: How many batches the whole list takes.

totalCount.description: How many exercises the whole list holds. At most batchCount * 100, the most the batches can carry.

exercises.description: This batch's slice of the list. At most 100: a longer list arrives as more batches.
